name: playwright-bdd-framework
description: BDD test automation framework for SauceDemo using Playwright, TypeScript and Cucumber

scripts.clean: rimraf reports screenshots allure-results allure-report && mkdirp reports screenshots
scripts.test:bdd:headed: npm run clean && cross-env HEADLESS=false cucumber-js
scripts.test:bdd:allure: npm run clean && cucumber-js && allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean
scripts.test:bdd:allure:open: npm run test:bdd:allure && allure open allure-report
scripts.test:bdd:qa: npm run clean && cross-env TEST_ENV=qa cucumber-js
scripts.test:bdd:uat: npm run clean && cross-env TEST_ENV=uat cucumber-js
